snippet.title: Pokémon Monomyth | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Pokémon Monomyth is a completely new adventure set in the world of Pokémon.
Set out on a journey that will take you through the Athanto Region's most treacherous, untamed wilds.
Athanto is teeming with dangerous Pokémon, and finding civilization again before sunset isn't always a guarantee.

Featuring...
-Over 360 brand new and returning Pokémon, with new moves, abilities and animations.
-200+ tracks in a brand new Original Soundtrack
-Thousands of wild Pokémon coat variations
-Contest Halls, Trainer Hill, Battle Frontier, and more!
-Asynchronous multiplayer features + Link Cable trading
-Sprawling environments that house many secrets
-Dozens of sidequests across the Athanto Region
-Adventure has extended its hand in invitation once more.

Will you heed the call?

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Thank you for watching!
We hope you look forward to playing Pokémon Monomyth.

For the latest updates, follow us on Twitter:

Lastly, don't forget to check our website:
https://monomyth.jp
